q: All waves are produced by a ____.
e: All waves are produced by a vibrating source. The physics in this sentence is built around vibrating source.

q: Wave motion is a method of transferring ____ by successive disturbances through the medium.
e: Wave motion is a method of transferring energy by successive disturbances through the medium. Energy here means the capacity to do work.

q: This movement of energy takes place without transferring ____.
e: This movement of energy takes place without transferring matter. Matter here means anything that has mass and occupies space.

q: The mechanical waves need material medium to propagate and cannot pass through ____.
e: The mechanical waves need material medium to propagate and cannot pass through vacuum. Vacuum here means a space emptied of air so electrons can travel freely in a tube.

q: Sound waves and seismic waves, which are produced by an earthquake, are ____.
e: Sound waves and seismic waves, which are produced by an earthquake, are mechanical waves. The physics in this sentence is built around mechanical waves.

q: Electromagnetic waves can pass through ____ and they do not need medium for propagation.
e: Electromagnetic waves can pass through vacuum and they do not need medium for propagation. Vacuum here means a space emptied of air so electrons can travel freely in a tube.
Light wave and X-rays are electromagnetic waves. The physics in this sentence is built around electromagnetic waves.
